adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts` a new refresh-token `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` + `prisma.credential.update(...)` is executed before returning a `new jsforce.Connection(...)`, with no conditional gating shown in the diff. This means constructing/obtaining the Salesforce connection now performs an extra network round trip and DB write each time that code path runs, and it does not use the new `refreshOAuthTokens` helper (unlike other integrations updated in this PR), so sync-enabled setups would still bypass the sync endpoint. The finding’s claim about an “unimported prisma” is not fully verifiable from the shown diff context (the file’s full import list isn’t included), but the unconditional refresh + bypassing `refreshOAuthTokens` is directly supported by the diff.
